discription: A simple sawtooth wave synth with ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Saw.ar(freq) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
